_meanings:
.²1 Having marks.
.²2 Possessed of good or auspicious marks, fortunate, lucky.
.²3 Prosperous, thriving.

.²1 The crane.

.²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a son of Daśaratha by his wife Sumitrā. [He was so much attached
 to Rāma from his very childhood that he became ready to accompany him
 during his travels, and took no small part in the several events that
 took place during the fourteen years of Rāmaʼs exile. In the war of Laṅkā
 he killed several powerful demons, but particularly Meghanāda, the most
 heroic of the sons of Rāvaṇa. He was at first mortally wounded by Meghanāda
 by means of a magical weapon, but was restored to life by Suṣeṇa by
 means of the medicinal drugs fetched by Māruti. One day, Time in the disguise
 of a hermit came to Rāma and said that he who should happen to see them
 converse in private should be immediately abandoned, which was agreed
 to. Lakṣmaṇa on one occasion intruded on their privacy and made the word
 of his brother true by throwing himself into the Śarayū; (see <ls>R. 15. 92-95.</ls>).
 He married Ūrmilā by whom he had two sons, Aṅgada and Chandraketu.];
 {#aTa lakzmaRAnugatakAntavapuH#} <ls>Śi. 9. 31</ls>.

.²1 A name, an appellation.
.²2 A mark, sign, token.
